description: Shared source-package limit archives (gzip-compressed USTAR). Every verifier decompresses an archive and checks it: Go sourceidentity.VerifyArchive, the Python runner, and the TypeScript runner. Package hashes were computed by the Python SDK. The TypeScript runner keeps a smaller cap of 1,024 files and 50 MiB and rejects larger packages with a diagnostic naming the Python runner. Byte-limit acceptance at exactly 256 MiB is not stored; it would require 256 MiB of data.

cases.description: 16,384 empty files: exactly the shared file limit
16,385 empty files: one above the shared file limit
one file header declaring 256 MiB + 1 byte with no body; verifiers must reject the declared size before reading
